claimBoundary: The source reference is the pinned decoded public-domain thumbnail already retained by the progressive real-photo corpus; it is not a camera-raw ground truth.

The objective is fixed before capture: mean per-channel non-overlapping 8x8 block SSIM, with RGB MAE only as an exact-score tie-break. It is an explicit engineering objective, not a validated human-opinion score.
All candidates share the same encoded JPEG, post-IDCT Y/Cb/Cr planes and integer YCbCr-to-RGB transform. Only chroma reconstruction changes.

For each retained source, every retained progressive scan script must produce the same final libjpeg PPM SHA-256, and the fancy-H/fancy-V candidate must reproduce that final variant RGB byte-for-byte before objective ranking is accepted.
The v3 adaptive candidate is retained as a known non-universal heuristic. Winning or losing this corpus cannot restore universal source-truth dominance.
Four photographs are a directional source-bound natural-image sample, not a population claim or default-backend qualification.
